title: The look guard judges the EmDash brand writes instead of ending the write step
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: emdash.settings and emdash.entryField pass through the look guard for the places the kit names, are held back for any other, and read-backs are reads.
